settings.heading: Fabric & Craftsmanship
settings.content:
Artisanal Quality: Handcrafted by master artisans in India using premium silks, breathable soft cottons, georgette, and rich velvets with fine handwork, Zari threadwork, and authentic mirror detailing.

Care Instructions: Dry clean recommended for silk, embellished suits, and blouses to preserve embroidery luster and fabric longevity.

settings.heading: Size & Fit Guide
settings.content:
European Sizing: All garments are tailored according to standard European sizes (DE 34–48 / XS–3XL) with built-in inner seam margins (up to 4 cm) for effortless tailoring.

Need Sizing Assistance? Contact our Berlin stylists directly via WhatsApp (+49 1551 0583042) for personal sizing and fitting guidance.

settings.heading: Occasions & Styling Guide
settings.content:
Recommended Occasions: Sangeet, Mehendi, Wedding Guest, Receptions, Diwali, Eid, and festive family celebrations across Europe.

Styling Tip: Pair with traditional Kundan or Polki jewellery, handcrafted bangles, and embellished juttis from our collection.

Ready-to-Wear: Designed with breathable luxury fabrics for effortless style and all-day festive comfort.

settings.heading: Shipping & Delivery from Berlin
settings.content:
Fast Dispatch: Dispatched from our Berlin hub within 24–48 hours via DHL tracked shipping.

Germany: 1–3 business days with DHL tracked delivery.

EU & Switzerland: 3–5 business days with zero customs or import duties across EU member states.

Try In Person: Visit our retail store & showroom at The Playce (Potsdamer Platz), Shop 55, Alte Potsdamer Str. 7, 10785 Berlin, or message us on WhatsApp (+49 1551 0583042) for inquiries.
